prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1310; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the accident you were involved in. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were driving when the collision occurred.

A: I was heading north on the main road in Conroe, near a shopping center, going maybe thirty miles an hour.

Q: And what happened next?

A: A car coming south crossed into my lane. I braked and turned, but we still hit front to front. It wasn't a hard impact, but enough that my airbag didn't deploy and I felt a jolt.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you exit the vehicle at the scene?

A: I got out and walked around for a few minutes. Then I sat back down because my lower back started to tighten up.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, a few hours later I went to urgent care. They said I had a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and use ice.

Q: Do you have any pain in other areas?

A: My neck is a little sore, but the lower back is the main problem. It's hard to sit for long periods.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to your back?

A: I had some stiffness years ago after lifting something, but nothing that needed treatment.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I was careful and didn't do anything to cause it. I'm hoping to get my car repaired and my back feeling better soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
